title: The long non-coding RNA RSDR protects against acute kidney injury in mice by interacting with hnRNPK to regulate DHODH-mediated ferroptosis.
authors: Li, Bojun; Lin, Fangyou; Song, Baofeng; Han, ShangTing; Ye, Zehua; Sun, Yushi; Wang, Peihan; Xia, Yuqi; Yu, Weimin; Zhou, Xiangjun; Cheng, Fan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究lncRNA RSDR与hnRNPK互作调控DHODH介导的铁死亡，核心是RNA-蛋白互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Acute kidney injury (AKI) is a serious clinical condition whose underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Here we identify a long non-coding RNA, RSDR, as a critical regulator of renal protection in AKI. RSDR interacts with the RNA-binding protein hnRNPK, forming a positive feedback loop that enhances the transcription of DHODH, a key ferroptosis-suppressing gene. Mechanistically, RSDR promotes the nuclear retention of hnRNPK and facilitates epigenetic activation of DHODH, thereby limiting ferroptosis in renal tubular epithelial cells. In vivo overexpression of RSDR attenuates ferroptosis and preserves renal function in male mice during AKI. Clinically, urinary RSDR levels are significantly reduced in patients with AKI, and machine learning analysis suggests potential utility in disease detection. These findings highlight RSDR as a central regulator of ferroptosis and provide mechanistic insights into lncRNA-mediated tubular protection in AKI.
abstract_zh: 急性肾损伤（AKI）是一种严重的临床状况，其潜在机制尚不清楚。在此，我们鉴定了一种长链非编码RNA，RSDR，作为AKI中肾脏保护的关键调控因子。RSDR与RNA结合蛋白hnRNPK相互作用，形成正反馈环路，增强DHODH（一种关键的铁死亡抑制基因）的转录。机制上，RSDR促进hnRNPK的核滞留，并促进DHODH的表观遗传激活，从而限制肾小管上皮细胞中的铁死亡。在体内过表达RSDR可减轻雄性小鼠AKI中的铁死亡并保护肾功能。临床上，AKI患者尿液中的RSDR水平显著降低，机器学习分析提示其在疾病检测中具有潜在应用价值。这些发现凸显了RSDR作为铁死亡的核心调控因子，并为lncRNA介导的AKI中肾小管保护提供了机制性见解。
